The company [[Uxiol Droid Manufacturing]] maintained a '''plant''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hallion]] that produced [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Scourge (Sith)|Scourge]] and the aide [[Sechel]] [[Mission to Hallion|infiltrated]] the plant to retrieve information on the identity of the [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] who were targeting [[Darth Nyriss]], and Scourge was forced to fight assault droids.
